briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate frontier race with new multi-agent systems as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with rapid model releases from major labs. Compute investments surge while regulatory scrutiny grows over deployment risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced agent orchestration. xAI Colossus 2 cluster enables real-time training runs exceeding 100k H100 equivalents. DeepSeek releases R2 with competitive coding benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level through adaptive multi-agent dialects.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC securing additional capacity. Google expands Stargate data centers in Texas and Arizona for 2027 scale-up.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dialect negotiation become mandatory for frontier deployments by 2028?
